label: Arista 720XP-48TXH-2C-S-5G
description: Arista CCS-720XP-48TXH-2C-S-5G - 1RU high-power Cognitive Campus PoE leaf, 5G variant of the 48TXH-2C-S (100M-5G mGig): 48x 5G RJ45 @ 90W (Ethernet1-48), 4x 25G SFP28 (Ethernet49-52) and 2x 100G QSFP28 (Ethernet53-54). 1,775 W of PoE with the two 1050 W supplies it ships with.

poe.note: Arista CCS-720XP data sheet, "Power Supply Models (mGig Platforms)" table, 720XP-48TXH-2C-S column: "Default Power Supply 2 x 1050 W" and "1Default Available PoE Power (Typ/Min) 1775 W / 1744 W".

notes: Census from the Arista sheet, read 2026-11-24. Product Highlights family line: "48x mGig (100M - 10G) RJ45 @ 90W / Uplinks: 2x 100G, 4x 25G". The mGig specification table gives Ports "48 RJ45 / 4 25G SFP / 2 100G QSFP" and the class rows 48 x 100M-10G UTP (90W 802.3bt) for the -S and 0 for the -S-5G, whose copper ports are the 100M-5G (90W) row. Ordering information names both: "CCS-720XP-48TXH-2C-S-2F ... 48 x 100M - 10G, 90W POE, 4x25G SFP28, 2x100G QSFP switch" and "CCS-720XP-48TXH-2C-S-5G-2F ... 48 x 100M - 5G, 90W POE, 4x25G SFP28, 2x100G QSFP switch". The SFP28/QSFP28 cage names come from those lines. This is the 90 W member of the family; the 48Y6 and 48ZC2 copper ports are 30 W and 60 W.
